query:
SELECT 
  'Compras' as tipo,
  SUM(liters_purchased) / 100 as total_litros
FROM fuel_purchases WHERE gallon_number = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Abastecimentos' as tipo,
  SUM(liters) / 100 as total_litros
FROM fuel_records WHERE gallon_number = 1;
